initialize_model_parallel_seed: initialize model parallel CUDA seeds for data and model parallel groups using a given seed value
fork_cuda_rng_state: fork the CUDA RNG state to perform operations then restore the original state using the tracker context manager
checkpoint_model_function: checkpoint a model or part of the model to save memory during training with proper RNG state tracking
add_cuda_rng_tracker: add a named CUDA RNG state to the tracker with a specific seed value for later forking
reset_cuda_rng_tracker: reset the CUDA RNG states tracker to its initial state clearing all tracked states and seeds
